# Never Modify Generated Files

Never modify generated files. Ever. No exceptions. This covers `*.schema.graphql`, anything inside a `__generated__/` directory, relay/codegen artifacts, and any file with a header comment indicating auto-generation. They are reproduced from source by a build step, so direct edits are silently overwritten and never land, and hand-edits create drift between local and CI/prod ("works on my machine" bugs that are hard to trace); the user considers modifying them a major rule violation. If a type is missing or wrong, update the source and regenerate. List the forbidden paths explicitly when briefing agents; if an agent returns with generated-file edits, reject the work and respawn with explicit warnings. Scan diffs for generated-file changes before commit and back them out.
